ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Direct Current Motors.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Direct Current Motors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Direct Current Motors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Direct Current Motors.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.

7. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.

8. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

9. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

11. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.

12. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Single phase Alternating Current Motors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single-Phase alternating current Transformers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Solar Photovoltaic Installation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Lamps and Lamp Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
